pub mod external;
mod private { pub mod mismatch { pub(crate) fn internal() {} } }
pub mod inline {
    pub use crate::{Root as Renamed, external::{Leaf, self}, *};
    pub const VALUE: u8 = 0;
    pub static STATIC: u8 = 0;
    pub type Alias = u8;
    pub struct Struct;
    pub enum Enum { A }
    pub trait Trait {}
    pub union Union { pub value: u8 }
    pub fn function() {}
    pub(crate) fn internal() {}
    pub(super) fn parent() {}
    fn private() { pub mod local { pub fn ignored() {} } }
    pub mod nested { pub fn nested() {} }
}
#[cfg(test)] pub mod tests { pub mod ignored {} }
#[doc(hidden)] pub mod hidden {}
pub mod inner_hidden { #![doc(hidden)] pub mod ignored {} }
#[cfg(any())] pub mod inactive { pub fn counted() {} }
#[path = r#"../support.rs"#] pub mod custom;
pub(crate) mod restricted { pub(self) fn local() {} pub(in crate) fn ancestor() {} }
pub(super) mod parent {}
pub(self) mod own {}
#[path = "not-present.rs"] pub mod unresolved;
pub struct Root;
macro_rules! opaque { () => { pub mod not_a_declaration {} } }
opaque!();
